visualCharacteristics: Text-only, 3-up grid of dark-grey boxes with uppercase titles; no images.
usage: One row per feature box. Each row has a single cell with an H3 title and one or more paragraphs. An optional image cell may be added before the text cell.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for short USP / benefit lists shown as equal boxes. For image-led teaser cards use the base cards block.
